objective: Characterize whether a finite portfolio of already-frozen V16/A/A+/F5/V68 signals can deliver a practical maximum of one or two high-quality MLB winner opportunities per eligible slate day, with short no-play droughts, without forcing plays or relaxing any frozen parent threshold.
adaptiveSelectionDisclosure: The 2024-2026_YTD outcomes have already been inspected in prior V9/V12/V14/V19/V66/V68 research. Therefore V69 is retrospective discovery/portfolio characterization only. Its results may define a future frozen prospective hypothesis but may not independently confirm or promote any route.

evaluationUniverse.slateDayDefinition: Official date containing at least one eligible game in the evaluation universe
evaluationUniverse.droughtDefinition: Consecutive ordered eligible slate days with zero selected opportunities; raw calendar off-days are not counted as drought days

frozenSignalSemantics.A: Use the existing frozen Premium A classifier exactly as implemented in mlb-frozen-a-plus-classifier.v1; no threshold change.
frozenSignalSemantics.A_PLUS: Use the existing frozen A+ classifier exactly as implemented in mlb-frozen-a-plus-classifier.v1. A+ remains a subset of Premium A.
frozenSignalSemantics.F5_CONSENSUS: Use the existing frozen F5 C4 and F5 Full13 models and thresholds exactly as implemented in mlb-frozen-a-plus-classifier.v1.
frozenSignalSemantics.A_PLUS_D1_ROUTER: For A+ only, bullpen_pitches_1d_adv > 0 routes HOME to FIRST_5; otherwise routes HOME to FULL_GAME, matching A_PLUS_BULLPEN_D1_F5_ELSE_FG_V1. bullpen_pitches_1d_adv is away workload minus home workload from chronology-safe V66/V14-equivalent custody.
frozenSignalSemantics.PREMIUM_A_ROUTE_SWITCH: For Premium A, route HOME to FIRST_5 when frozen F5 Consensus matches; otherwise route HOME to FULL_GAME. This preserves the frozen V19 route-switch semantics.
frozenSignalSemantics.V16: Frozen Full Game binary C4 probability from the immutable V16 manifest; no refit or recalibration.
frozenSignalSemantics.V68: Exact frozen V68 15-feature Full Game binary probability from the V68 contract; no refit, recalibration, feature change, exposure change, or bullpen addition.
frozenSignalSemantics.V16_V68_AGREEMENT: V16 and V68 select the same Full Game side at the 0.5 decision boundary.
frozenSignalSemantics.V68_REINFORCES_V16: After V16 and V68 agree on side, V68 assigned probability to that selected side is greater than or equal to V16 assigned probability to the same side.
frozenSignalSemantics.EXPOSURE_SIGN_SUPPORT: For a HOME selection fg_exposure_adv > 0; for an AWAY selection fg_exposure_adv < 0. Zero gives no sign support. No magnitude threshold may be learned or used in V69.

consensusScoreDefinition: min(V16 probability of selected side, V68 probability of selected side), conditional on V16_V68_AGREEMENT
